title: Zesty Indulgent Irish Lamb Stew
description: A rich and comforting Irish stew featuring tender lamb, little gem lettuce, and the depth of kombu-cold-extract, made with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients for a nourishing meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, salt, and pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot, along with the lamb broth and kombu-cold-extract.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped little gem lettuce and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional little gem lettuce if desired.
